steps.observation: Current cross-lingual models work by pre-training multilingual representations using some form of language modeling, which are then fine-tuned on the relevant task and transferred to different languages. Some authors leverage parallel data to that end BIBREF5, BIBREF6, but training a model akin to BERT BIBREF7 on the combination of monolingual corpora in multiple languages is also effective BIBREF8. Closely related to our work, BIBREF4 showed that replacing segments of the training data with their translation during fine-tuning is helpful. However, they attribute this behavior to a data augmentation effect, which we believe should be reconsidered given the new evidence we provide.
